sentences.text:
Lakhan Roy vs State Of West Bengal & Anr on 11 April, 2025
D/L - 36
11/04/2025

Court No.655
S.Kundu
 Cra 728 of 2016
 With
 Cran 1 of 2016 (Old No. 4935 of 2016)
 Lakhan Roy
 Vs.
 State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Ms. Faria Hossain,
 Mr. Rajashi Tah
 ...for the State.
 1.
2. Ms. Hossain, learned advocate for the State is present in Court.

3. This appeal is preferred at the behest of the appellant/convicted challenging the impugned judgment and order of conviction dated 22nd September, 2015 and 23rd September, 2015 passed by the learned Trial Court wherein this appellant was found guilty for commission of offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and was sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for seven years along with fine and in default payment of fine to undergo further R.I for two months.
An application praying for bail and suspension of sentence were taken out at the behest of the appellant/convict but that prayer was turned down by the Court on 23rd February, 2017.
Presumably, this appellant either served out the sentence or still in the correctional home.

4. Department is directed to obtain a report from the concerned correctional home, as to whether the appellant has already served out the sentence as directed by the learned Trial Court in the impugned judgment and order and submit the same before the next date of hearing.
5. Department is directed to hand over the paper book to the learned advocate for the State.
6. Let this matter appear in the daily list on 23rd May, 2025.

(Prasenjit Biswas, J.)
